description: GameHub JSONB: views, array, bevarende opdatering og GIN

assertions.sql: SELECT handle, rating FROM v_ranked_players ORDER BY handle
assertions.message: Invitationslisten indeholder de rigtige profiler og ratings

assertions.sql: SELECT game, hours FROM v_game_hours ORDER BY game
assertions.message: Spiltimer er summeret korrekt på tværs af dokumenterne

assertions.sql: SELECT profile = '{"handle":"Nova","region":"EU","rating":1450,"settings":{"theme":"high-contrast"},"games":[{"slug":"rocket","hours":24},{"slug":"valorant","hours":12}]}'::jsonb FROM player_profiles WHERE id=1
assertions.message: Novas tema er ændret uden at miste profilens øvrige indhold

assertions.sql: SELECT id, CASE id WHEN 2 THEN profile = '{"handle":"Pixel","region":"EU","rating":1280,"settings":{"theme":"light"},"games":[{"slug":"rocket","hours":12},{"slug":"minecraft","hours":18}]}'::jsonb WHEN 3 THEN profile = '{"handle":"Rune","region":"EU","rating":990,"settings":{"theme":"dark"},"games":[{"slug":"valorant","hours":20}]}'::jsonb WHEN 4 THEN profile = '{"handle":"Echo","region":"NA","rating":1600,"settings":{"theme":"dark"},"games":[]}'::jsonb ELSE FALSE END FROM player_profiles WHERE id<>1 ORDER BY id
assertions.message: De andre profiler er bevaret uden datatab

assertions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM pg_indexes WHERE schemaname='public' AND tablename='player_profiles' AND indexname='ix_player_profiles_profile' AND indexdef ILIKE '%USING gin (profile)%'
